evidence.title: Ramapo Housing and Residence Life › Laurel Hall - Residence Life › Laurel Hall Building Features
evidence.content:
### Laurel Hall Building Features

Laurel Hall shares the quad with Pine Hall, and is near to the Scott Student Center, Birch Tree Inn and the Atrium. Laurel Hall is a 432-bed suite-style residence that contains four single bedrooms, a bathroom with stall shower and a small common area. The community space has a kitchenette-type unit with a sink, microwave and full-size refrigerator along with some storage space for food items; a small table with four chairs, a couch, club chair, coffee table, and TV cart. Each bedroom has an adjustable long twin bed that can be raised to captain’s height, mattress, three-drawer chest, desk with movable pedestal drawer unit (can be used as a night table), task chair on casters, overhead bookcase storage unit (seven feet wide), tack board, and wardrobe with two doors (half hanging clothes and half shelves), desk and desk chair. Each bedroom door is accessed through student ID card for to the resident of the bedroom. Hall office on first floor. Screening room, kitchen for resident use, and game room on the first floor. Outdoor basketball and volleyball courts with picnic area and grills. First and second floor lounge space.

evidence.content:
### Bischoff Hall Building Features

Bischoff Hall is adjacent to the Trustees Pavilion. A five-story building, with elevator access, houses about 250 students in hotel-like large rooms, configured for two resident students. Furnishings include bed, mattress, large desk with rolling pedestal storage unit, desk, desk chair, overhead bookcase/storage, tack board, chest of drawers, wardrobe, and bookcase/storage unit are provided in each bedroom; Flat screen televisions and Wi-Fi in all floor lounges Hall office on first floor Outdoor amphitheater-like seating Outdoor picnic area and grills State-of-the-art gaming equipment in fourth-floor lounges in both residence halls Bischoff Hall is designated as dry (alcohol prohibited) regardless of age. Bedroom, approx. 14’-7” x 15′ Bischoff Hall residents are required to have meal plans.

If the reset page fails, contact the IT Help Desk and include any error message you see.

parts.text: Yes. Ramapo offers an Environmental Science BS major and an Environmental Science Minor through the School of Theoretical and Applied Science. It also offers an Environmental Studies Minor through the School of Social Science and Human Services.

For organizations, the student organization directory lists Sunrise RCNJ, Garden Club, RCNJ Birding, and Ramapo College Beekeeping Club as student organizations. It also lists Ramapo Green, but that entry is categorized as a department rather than a student organization.

I could verify those organization names and categories, but the records I found did not include mission descriptions, so I can’t confirm from this data alone which ones are specifically focused on environmental science versus adjacent interests.
